summary: ITER65 PLAN + COACH domain extraction verified. 28/29 tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter65_plan_coach_refactor.py against the external base URL. ONE critical refactor regression found: POST /api/calendar/review returns 500 (Internal Server Error) because `os` and `coach_system` were not imported when `review_calendar_change` was moved into routes/plan.py — `key = os.environ.get('EMERGENT_LLM_KEY')` raises NameError immediately (backend log confirms: 'NameError: name os is not defined at /app/backend/routes/plan.py, line 510'). Additionally, static analysis found 4 SILENT-degradation NameErrors in routes/coach.py — all wrapped in try/except so they don't 500 but they DISABLE the features they gate: (a) `plans_admin` at coach.py:402 (companion plan-edit intent inside /coach/chat), (b) `plans_admin` at coach.py:491 (adaptive plan easing after /coach/debrief), (c) `WELLNESS_DATA` at coach.py:343-344 (readiness snippet in coach chat rider_ctx), (d) `get_plan` + `json` at coach.py:528 & 764 & 739 (structured-plan grounding + JSON parse in /coach/adaptation/detail). These do not fail the current test assertions (endpoints still return 200/2xx or acceptable 502/503) because they are wrapped in `try/except: logging.warning(...)` or the JSON path is only hit inside an already-broad `try/except` that returns 502. Coverage otherwise: PLAN routes (GET /plan → couch-to-road resolves with weeks/phase/progress_pct, /rider/plan, non-destructive assign→restore of greenlantern's plan, /onboarding/recommend, /plan/targets, /plan/adaptations, PUT /plan/goals, /plan/progress); CALENDAR + PROGRESS (calendar/week?start=2026-07-27 seven-day payload, calendar/scheduled CRUD create→list→delete cleanup, calendar/move smoke 200/400, workout-favorites toggle+restore, /progress, /progress/timeline?range=3m, /rider/missed); COACH (chat/history GET, extend-advice, coach/cue 200, coach/chat roundtrip persisting user+coach messages, coach/adaptation, coach/adaptation/detail); REGRESSION on previously-extracted domains (/rider/profile 200, /benchmark/profile ftp=305 preserved, /benchmark/plan-gate?plan_id=couch-to-road 200, /benchmark/recommendation 200); ADMIN cross-module sync (POST /admin/login → GET /admin/benchmark/config → PUT ftp_retest_days 56→60→56 restore verified end-to-end, GET /admin/coaches 200); PLAN hot-reload (GET /plan still resolves same id after PUT /plan/goals). All mutated state restored (assigned plan restored to couch-to-road; scheduled workout created was deleted; workout-favorite toggled twice back to original; goals overwritten with placeholder — see action items; ftp_retest_days restored to original). WebSocket /api/ws/telemetry not exercised (optional).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error — routes/plan.py line 510 references `os.environ.get(...)` and line 530 references `coach_system(...)` but neither `os` nor `coach_system` is imported in routes/plan.py. Traceback in backend log: `NameError: name 'os' is not defined`. The refactor extracted review_calendar_change out of server.py but did not carry the imports. Fix: add `import os` and `from services.coach_llm import coach_system` to routes/plan.py.

minor.issue: SILENT DEGRADATION — routes/coach.py line 402 calls `plans_admin.get_plan_def(plan_id)` but `plans_admin` is not imported in coach.py. Wrapped in try/except so /coach/chat still returns 200, but the entire companion plan-edit path is disabled: any 'move my ride to Thursday' style message no longer updates the plan (silently logs `chat plan-edit failed`). Fix: add `import plans_admin`.

SILENT DEGRADATION — routes/coach.py line 491 (`_refresh_adaptation_after_ride`) calls `plans_admin.get_plan_def(plan_id)` without importing `plans_admin`. Adaptive plan easing on low-compliance rides is silently disabled (logs `adaptive plan easing failed`). Fix: add `import plans_admin`.

SILENT DEGRADATION — routes/coach.py lines 343-344 (`_build_rider_context`) references `WELLNESS_DATA.get('readiness', ...)` but `WELLNESS_DATA` was left behind in routes/plan.py (line 572) and never imported into coach.py. Coach chat rider context loses the readiness/sleep/HRV snippet (silently logs `readiness lookup failed`). Fix: either import `from routes.plan import WELLNESS_DATA` or (better) move WELLNESS_DATA into a shared services module.

TWO SILENT DEGRADATIONS in one path: (a) routes/coach.py line 764 calls `get_plan(id=req.plan_id)` — but `get_plan` is defined in routes/plan.py and not imported here → structured plan grounding is silently skipped for couch-to-road/ride-stronger/ride-beyond adaptation-detail requests. (b) routes/coach.py line 739 calls `json.loads(raw)` without `import json` → when cache miss AND LLM succeeds, this endpoint raises NameError inside its outer try/except and returns 502. `_refresh_adaptation_after_ride` at line 528 also calls `get_plan(...)` similarly (best-effort so silent). Fix: `import json` and `from routes.plan import get_plan` (or extract get_plan into services).
Intermittent 502/503 from upstream LLM (litellm/Anthropic) — same PRE-EXISTING flakiness noted in iter64. Not introduced by this refactor. Endpoint code path is correct.

action_items: routes/plan.py: add `import os` (used at line 510) AND `from services.coach_llm import coach_system` (used at line 530). Without these POST /api/calendar/review 500s.
routes/coach.py: add `import json` (used at line 739 in _generate_adaptation_detail).
routes/coach.py: add `import plans_admin` (used at lines 402 and 491).

routes/coach.py: resolve `WELLNESS_DATA` (used at lines 343-344) — either `from routes.plan import WELLNESS_DATA` or lift WELLNESS_DATA into services/rider_common.py (cleaner, avoids routes→routes coupling).

routes/coach.py: resolve `get_plan` (used at lines 528 and 764) — either `from routes.plan import get_plan` or refactor structured-plan resolution into services/plan_engine.py so both routers can call it without cross-router imports. The latter is aligned with the current architecture (routes call services).
Optional (test hygiene): GoalsUpdateRequest requires `id` field in each goal (Pydantic 422 otherwise). Not a refactor bug — was already required — but worth documenting.
Consider re-enabling ESLint / a pyflakes-style CI check to catch these missing-import regressions automatically during future extractions.
critical_code_review_comments: Extraction depth is correct (coach → plan_engine → plan_common one-way) but 6 missing imports slipped in during the move. Static analysis with `ruff` / `pyflakes` on routes/*.py would have caught all of them in seconds: `os` in plan.py; `json`, `plans_admin`, `WELLNESS_DATA`, `get_plan` in coach.py. Two of them (coach_system, os in plan.py) cause hard 500s; four cause silent degradation because they sit inside try/except blocks.

The `# noqa: F401` markers on almost every import in the new files suggest a linter WAS run but was silenced everywhere. This masked real bugs. Recommend removing blanket noqa and treating F821 (undefined name) as a build failure.
routes/coach.py imports `companion_plan` but not `plans_admin` — a common pairing. The two go together in this codebase and both should have been carried.

WELLNESS_DATA lives in routes/plan.py at module scope but is read by coach chat context (routes/coach.py). This creates a latent routes→routes dependency. Move it to services/rider_common.py or services/wellness.py before the next iteration.

rca_of_issue: RCA: When server.py was chopped into routes/plan.py and routes/coach.py, the code blocks were moved but the top-of-file `import` statements in server.py were only PARTIALLY carried into the new modules. server.py imports `os`, `json`, `plans_admin`, `coach_system`, defines `WELLNESS_DATA` and `get_plan` — all of which are still referenced by functions now in coach.py/plan.py. Because `coach_system` and `os` are used at the TOP of `review_calendar_change` (before any try/except), that endpoint immediately 500s. The four missing symbols in coach.py sit inside `try: ... except: logging.warning(...)` blocks that were designed to swallow LLM/DB errors but end up swallowing the NameError too — the endpoints still respond 200 but with degraded functionality. REPRODUCTION for the 500: POST {BASE}/api/calendar/review with any valid ReviewRequest body → 500 Internal Server Error, backend log shows NameError('os'). MITIGATION: add the 6 missing imports listed in action_items. VERIFICATION: re-run the pytest file — test_calendar_review should flip to PASS, all others should remain PASS.
